purpose: Limit what is included in a statement.
keywords: Noun or plain-form phrase + だけ.
In the morning, I drink only coffee.
Today I will work for just one hour.
I will only look; I will not buy anything.
Restrict a choice with だけ or しか～ない
formation: Noun or plain-form phrase + だけ.
restrictions: The restricted item follows from the context; だけ does not itself require a negative predicate.
mistake: Keep the placement close to the item being limited.
